concepts.def: An energy source that is replenished as fast as it is used, e.g. wind, solar, hydro.
An energy source that will run out, e.g. coal, oil, natural gas, nuclear fuel.
Coal, oil and gas formed from ancient organisms; release CO₂ when burned.
Kinetic energy of moving air turns turbines; renewable but intermittent.
Photovoltaic cells or solar heating; renewable but depends on weather/daylight.
Energy from fission of uranium; high output, no CO₂ at point of use, but produces radioactive waste.
